summary.text: Ella George was elected as Labor's member for Lara in 2022, taking over from the retiring MP John Eren. The seat covers Geelong's northern suburbs. She chaired the Assembly's Legal and Social Issues Committee from 2023 to 2026 and has been Parliamentary Secretary for Mental Health and Suicide Prevention since April 2026. She is recontesting Lara in 2026.

occupation.text: Family violence policy reform in the Magistrates' Courts

prior_roles.role: Parliamentary Secretary for Mental Health and Suicide Prevention
Chair, Legislative Assembly Legal and Social Issues Committee

prior_roles.note: The Parliament biography gives no years.

priorities.text: Equal educational opportunity for students wherever they live
Giving young people a say in decisions
Issues that affect women
A fairer, more inclusive community

summary.text: Oliver Randall is the Victorian Socialists candidate for Lara at the 2026 Victorian election. He describes himself as a socialist who has lived and worked in Geelong for a long time. He says Geelong and the wider west have missed out on investment in trains, roads and buses, and opposes the planned demolition and sale of public housing.

priorities.text: I want a Victoria where working people can afford a home
Properly funded public services, with regional Victoria no longer treated as an afterthought
Reliable trains, better buses and less congested roads in Geelong and the west
Upgrading public housing rather than demolishing and selling it
A multicultural Victoria that rejects hate and division

sources.title: Lara: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News
Oliver Randall, Victorian Socialists

summary.text: Sarah Hathway is standing for Socialist Alliance in Lara at the 2026 Victorian election; the ABC notes that the party is not registered in Victoria. She is a social worker in community mental health and a long-time socialist activist, and sat on the City of Greater Geelong council for Windermere Ward from mid-2023, after a countback, until the 2024 council election. She ran for Lara as an independent in 2022, winning 2.7 per cent of the primary vote.

occupation.text: Social worker in community mental health services

summary.text: Steven Spyros is the One Nation candidate for Lara at the 2026 Victorian election. The ABC's guide says he has lived in the area all his life and has been with Victoria Police since 2018, starting as a protective services officer and becoming a sworn police officer in 2021. summary.text: Theresa Slater is the Greens candidate for Lara at the 2026 Victorian election. Born and raised in Geelong, she is a mother and a social worker with over 15 years' experience supporting vulnerable families and people with disability. She is campaigning on housing, healthcare and the environment.

previous_candidacies.note: Wikipedia's results list a Greens candidate of this name in this ward, which is inside the Lara electorate; no source we read links that candidacy to her.

priorities.text: We need representatives that actually listen to the Lara community.
Action on housing, including for people facing housing insecurity
Better access to healthcare and essential services
Protecting the environment and acting on climate change

summary.text: Tim Beddoe is the Liberal candidate for Lara at the 2026 Victorian election: the Liberal Party's own candidate page, updated in early November 2026, lists him as its candidate for the seat, although the ABC's guide had not yet added him. He began his career as a train driver and then spent close to twenty years in management and senior roles on major Victorian rail infrastructure projects. A Liberal candidate of the same name stood for the federal seat of Maribyrnong in 2025.

occupation.text: Rail infrastructure manager; former train driver

previous_candidacies.note: Wikipedia lists a Liberal candidate of this name for Maribyrnong; his Liberal candidate page for Lara does not mention it.

priorities.text: Safer communities, with enough frontline police and real consequences for offenders
Infrastructure and services to keep up with Lara's growing population
More open and accountable government that delivers on its promises

sources.title: Tim Beddoe, Liberal for Lara, Liberal Victoria

summary.text: Tina Uwizeyimana is the Family First candidate for Lara at the 2026 Victorian election; her party page gives her first name as Clementine and says she is known as Tina. According to the page she was born in Rwanda, came to Australia in her twenties and became a citizen in 2013, and she is the mother of 12 children and works five days a week. It says her main concerns are children's wellbeing and support for families.

priorities.text: Protecting children's wellbeing
Supporting parents and strengthening families
Not forgetting the community's vulnerable members
